artifacts.name: starter-llms.txt
artifacts.content:
# Northline

> Northline Advisory Ltd — replace this paragraph with: who you are, where,
> who founded you, what you do, and what you explicitly do not do.

## Pages
- [Northline | Advisory](https://staging.northline.example/): We help teams.
- [Orphan](https://staging.northline.example/orphan/): Orphan

findings.title: Keep the staging host out of the index
findings.what: Staging host staging.northline.example appears indexable (no noindex meta and no X-Robots-Tag: noindex on the checked response).
findings.why: A canonical is a hint, not a rule. If anyone links to staging, Google may index it as a duplicate, and AI crawlers often ignore canonicals.
findings.fix: Send `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` only when the request host is the staging host (Worker rule or Cloudflare Transform Rule). Do not put noindex in HTML that ships to production.

findings.title: Redirect the old URLs
findings.what: 2 known legacy URL(s) need permanent redirects (301) onto the current IA. Examples: /old-services/, /book-a-call/
findings.why: Without 301s, bookmarks, social posts and AI-answer citations become dead ends, and Google drops the URLs without passing value on.
findings.fix: Add a redirects file (or platform equivalent) with permanent 301s, one line per old URL. Keep it at least a year.

findings.title: Fix titles, meta descriptions and H1s
findings.what: 1 page(s) missing meta description
findings.why: Titles and a single clear H1 are the baseline for both classic SEO and AI citation snippets.
findings.fix: Give every indexable page a unique title, a meta description, and exactly one H1 that matches the page intent.

findings.title: Add an Organization (or ProfessionalService) to the schema
findings.what: JSON-LD is present (WebSite) but there is no Organization / ProfessionalService entity for the business itself.
findings.why: Without an organisation entity, engines may treat the brand as a topic or confuse it with namesakes. AI assistants invent descriptions when the entity is unclear.
findings.fix: Add ProfessionalService (or Organization) with name, legalName ("Northline Advisory Ltd"), url, address, founder, sameAs profile links, and knowsAbout.

findings.title: A proper social preview image
findings.what: og:image is set but twitter:card is "summary" (prefer summary_large_image with a 1200×630 image).
findings.why: Shared links on LinkedIn otherwise show a cropped logo or empty preview.
findings.fix: Create one 1200×630 image (logo + headline), set as default og:image, use summary_large_image.

findings.title: The contact form posts to mailto:
findings.what: Found mailto form action(s): https://staging.northline.example/ → mailto:hello@northline.example
findings.why: This is a conversion issue more than an SEO one, but it is the page SEO work sends people to. On many phones and locked-down work machines, mailto does nothing.
findings.fix: Post to a real form endpoint (HubSpot, Formspree, etc.) and show the email address as plain-text fallback.

findings.title: Search demand and content fit
findings.what: Configured focus themes/keywords to validate with search-volume data: incident review, observability advisory.
findings.why: Category keywords often have tiny demand for advisory businesses; buyers search symptoms or ask AI assistants.
findings.fix: Pull monthly volumes (DataForSEO / Ads Keyword Planner) for the configured markets, then write problem-led pages that open with a two-sentence direct answer and link to the matching service.

agentAction.notes: Fill volumes via keyword collector or agent research, then prioritise content.

findings.title: Win the brand search on purpose
findings.what: Brand strings to verify in Google (GB): Northline. Known namesakes/competitors: https://other-northline.example/.
findings.why: Prospects who hear the name will search it. They need to land on the right domain, not a namesake.
findings.fix: Put brand + place + category together in the home title or first paragraph. Align LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and other sameAs profiles on the exact name and URL.

findings.title: Thin indexable pages
findings.what: 1 indexable page(s) have under 80 words. Examples: https://staging.northline.example/ (5).
findings.why: Thin URLs rarely match a search intent and dilute the crawl.
findings.fix: Expand the page into a real answer, merge it into a stronger URL, or noindex it.

findings.title: No analytics snippet on the homepage
findings.what: The homepage HTML does not reference a common analytics tag.
findings.why: Without a measurement baseline, later ranking work has no success metric.
findings.fix: Confirm analytics is loaded (it may be injected after consent) and that someone can read landing-page conversions.

findings.title: Focus themes are absent from titles and openings
findings.what: These configured themes do not appear in any crawled title, H1, or opening: incident review, observability advisory.
findings.why: A theme that is not in the page is not a page yet. Volume data comes next, after the gap is visible.
findings.fix: Decide which theme is a real page with an intent, and which is only a way you describe the work.

findings.title: Redirect chains or temporary redirects
findings.what: 1 URL(s) hop more than once or return 302. Example: 302 https://northline.example/old-services/ → 301 https://northline.example/services/ → 200 https://northline.example/services/.
findings.why: Chains waste crawl and drop equity. A 302 on a retired URL tells search the move is temporary.
findings.fix: Point each retired URL at its final target with a single 301.

findings.title: Sitemap URLs with no internal link
findings.what: 1 crawled sitemap URL(s) are not linked from any other crawled page.
findings.why: Orphans are hard for people and crawlers to discover, and they often mark a template that was never wired into navigation.
findings.fix: Link them from a relevant hub, or remove them from the sitemap and noindex them.

findings.title: Sitemap lists noindex URLs
findings.what: 1 URL(s) are in the sitemap and also marked noindex.
findings.why: The sitemap asks for indexing and the tag refuses it. Search Console will report the conflict.
findings.fix: Remove noindex URLs from the sitemap, or remove noindex from URLs that should rank.

findings.title: What competing homepages lead with
findings.what: https://other-northline.example/: Oil and gas software
findings.why: The content gap is against the pages that already rank, not against a keyword list.
findings.fix: For each focus theme, open the ranking URL and note the intent it satisfies before writing.

findings.title: No Wikidata item for the brand
findings.what: A Wikidata search for "Northline" returned no item.
findings.why: Knowledge panels and several AI systems lean on a stable entity, not only on the website.
findings.fix: If the organisation is notable enough, create one item with the legal name, official site, and same profiles the schema lists. Otherwise make those profiles consistent so a future item is unambiguous.

findings.title: Field Core Web Vitals were not queried
findings.what: No Chrome UX Report sample was attached to this run.
findings.why: Lab Lighthouse is not a substitute for field LCP, INP, and CLS.
findings.fix: Set CRUX_API_KEY and re-run at deep, or paste the CrUX origin numbers into the report.

findings.title: Search baseline
findings.what: incident review (120 impressions, pos 18)
findings.why: Recommendations should protect queries that already earn impressions.
findings.fix: Keep these URLs stable. Re-check the same queries after the changes.

findings.title: Landing pages with visits and no conversions
findings.what: https://northline.example/services/ (80 sessions)
findings.why: These URLs already receive demand. The gap is the page, not the crawl.
findings.fix: Check the promise above the fold against the query that lands here, then the action and the proof.

findings.title: Bot log requests URLs the crawl does not return
findings.what: 1 logged path(s) are missing or 404 in this crawl. Examples: /old-services/.
findings.why: That is what the crawler actually asked for, which a sitemap sample can miss.
findings.fix: 301 the ones that moved. Let the junk 404. Do not put them back into the sitemap.
